paragraphs.text: The loaded ledgers only cover {{p:2025-04}}, {{p:2025-05}} and {{p:2025-06}}, so a figure for March of that year is not available in this data.
The loaded MIS tables (trial balance and pending bills) do not contain employee or payroll headcount data, so this cannot be answered from the available data.

The loaded data only contains trial balance ledger balances and pending bills receivable/payable; there is no inventory or item-level stock data in these tables. I cannot determine unit stock for any item, including a best-selling one.
